2. The short facts of the case are, that the opposite party No. 1 being complainant instituted the aforesaid complaint case in the court of the Upazila Magistrate, Paikgacha, on the allegations that he took lease of the case land from one Amodini Dashi by an amalnama dated 7th Chaitra, 1356 BS and has been possessing the same by paying rents up to date. One Pancharam Saha being plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 86 of 1985 in the Court of the Assistant Judge, Paikgacha, with respect of the land impleading the complainant opposite party No. 1 as defendant, who has been contesting the same by filing written statement. On 4.5.91 he came to learn from the local Tahsilder that petitioner No.2, the wife of petitioner No.1, recorded her name in pattan Case No. 323 of 1990-91 on the basis of a Kabala No. 688 dated 23.2.91 showing herself as owner with respect to the self-same land and while recording her name in the Revenue Office also submitted another photo copy of a Kabala No. 1742 wherein Amodini Dashi is vendor and accused-petitioner No. 1 is the vendee and thereafter complainant opposite Party No. 1 filed a Review Case under section 150 of the Tenancy Act before the Revenue Officer. Further on the basis of those kabalas she filed an application in the aforesaid title suit for impleading her as a party. 

 4. Mr. Abdul Jabbar, the learned Advocate for the petitioners, submits that the complainant opposite party No. 1 has got no locus-standi to file this instant criminal case against the petitioners and the proceeding is liable to be quashed. The learned Advocate for the petitioner led us through the petition of complaint wherein it is specifically alleged that accused-petitioner No. 2 in collusion with her husband petitioner No. 1 got her name mutated with respect to the disputed land in pattan Case No. 323/90-91 at the Sholo Dana Revenue Office producing the aforesaid kabalas and further on the basis of these kabalas she filed an application in Title Suit No. 86 of 1985 in the Court of the Assistant Judge, Paikgacha for adding her as a party in the suit.
